True Nuclear Reset: Drop EVERYTHING in public schema regardless of migration order\nDO $$ DECLARE\n    r RECORD;\nBEGIN\n    -- Drop all tables\n    FOR r IN (SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname = 'public') LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS public.' || quote_ident(r.tablename) || ' CASCADE';\n    END LOOP;\n    \n    -- Drop all functions (excluding extensions)\n    FOR r IN (\n        SELECT proname, oidvectortypes(proargtypes) as args \n        FROM pg_proc \n        JOIN pg_namespace ON pg_proc.pronamespace = pg_namespace.oid \n        WHERE pg_namespace.nspname = 'public'\n    ) LOOP\n        EXECUTE 'DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS public.' || quote_ident(r.proname) || '(' || r.args || ') CASCADE';\n    END LOOP;\nEND $$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 1: CLIENT BILLING \u0026 SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT (Replaces Organizations)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_billing (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  firebase_uid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  phone TEXT,\n  station_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- Primary station/Company name\n  station_location TEXT, -- Headquarters or primary location\n  county TEXT, -- Nairobi, Nakuru, Kiambu, etc.\n  \n  -- Financial tracking\n  current_debt DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00 CHECK (current_debt \u003e= 0),\n  total_paid DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,\n  lifetime_revenue DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,\n  \n  -- Subscription management\n  subscription_tier TEXT DEFAULT 'basic' CHECK (subscription_tier IN ('basic', 'pro', 'enterprise')),\n  subscription_status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (subscription_status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'cancelled', 'trial')),\n  trial_ends_at TIMESTAMP,\n  subscription_started_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  last_payment_date TIMESTAMP,\n  next_billing_date DATE,\n  \n  -- Account status\n  account_status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (account_status IN ('active', 'suspended', 'delinquent', 'closed')),\n  suspension_reason TEXT,\n  grace_period_ends TIMESTAMP,\n  \n  -- Metadata\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  last_login TIMESTAMP,\n  \n  CONSTRAINT valid_email CHECK (email ~* '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$')\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 1.5: SITES (To support multi-location clients)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sites (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  address TEXT,\n  latitude DOUBLE PRECISION,\n  longitude DOUBLE PRECISION,\n  tank_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,\n  manager_name TEXT,\n  contact_phone TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 2: TRANSACTION LEDGER (Immutable Financial Record)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS transactions (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN (\n    'charge',           -- Monthly subscription charge\n    'usage_charge',     -- Pay-as-you-go usage\n    'payment',          -- Client payment received\n    'refund',           -- Money returned to client\n    'adjustment',       -- Manual correction by admin\n    'penalty',          -- Late payment fee\n    'discount',         -- Promotional discount\n    'credit'            -- Account credit\n  )),\n  \n  amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,\n  currency TEXT DEFAULT 'KES',\n  \n  payment_method TEXT CHECK (payment_method IN ('mpesa', 'stripe', 'paypal', 'bank_transfer', 'manual', 'crypto')),\n  payment_reference TEXT,\n  payment_status TEXT DEFAULT 'completed' CHECK (payment_status IN ('pending', 'completed', 'failed', 'reversed', 'disputed')),\n  \n  description TEXT NOT NULL,\n  admin_notes TEXT,\n  invoice_number TEXT,\n  receipt_url TEXT,\n  \n  reverses_transaction_id UUID REFERENCES transactions(id),\n  reversed_by_transaction_id UUID REFERENCES transactions(id),\n  \n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  completed_at TIMESTAMP,\n  \n  created_by TEXT, -- Admin user who created\n  ip_address INET,\n  user_agent TEXT\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 3: USAGE TRACKING (For Metered Billing)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS usage_logs (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  usage_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (usage_type IN (\n    'api_call', 'storage_gb', 'sms_sent', 'email_sent', 'data_export', 'ai_query', 'sensor_reading', 'tank_monitored'\n  )),\n  \n  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1 CHECK (quantity \u003e 0),\n  unit_cost DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0.00,\n  total_cost DECIMAL(10,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (quantity * unit_cost) STORED,\n  \n  resource_id TEXT,\n  metadata JSONB,\n  \n  billing_period_start DATE,\n  billing_period_end DATE,\n  is_billed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  billed_transaction_id UUID REFERENCES transactions(id),\n  \n  timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 4: TANK CONFIGURATION\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tanks (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  site_id UUID REFERENCES sites(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, -- Added to support multi-site\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  tank_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  tank_code TEXT,\n  \n  tank_shape TEXT CHECK (tank_shape IN ('horizontal_cylinder', 'vertical_cylinder', 'rectangular', 'capsule')),\n  tank_capacity DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL CHECK (tank_capacity \u003e 0),\n  tank_radius DECIMAL(10,2), -- meters\n  tank_length DECIMAL(10,2), -- meters\n  tank_height DECIMAL(10,2), -- meters (used for calibration)\n  \n  fuel_type TEXT CHECK (fuel_type IN ('diesel', 'petrol', 'kerosene', 'jet_fuel', 'other')),\n  fuel_density DECIMAL(6,4), -- kg/L\n  molar_mass DECIMAL(6,4), -- kg/mol\n  \n  sensor_id TEXT UNIQUE,\n  sensor_type TEXT DEFAULT 'A02YYUW',\n  sensor_offset DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0, -- Dead zone in mm\n  last_calibration_date DATE,\n  calibration_due_date DATE,\n  \n  current_volume DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 0,\n  current_temperature DECIMAL(5,2),\n  standard_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  last_reading_at TIMESTAMP,\n  \n  low_level_threshold DECIMAL(10,2) DEFAULT 500,\n  high_temperature_threshold DECIMAL(5,2) DEFAULT 60,\n  leak_detection_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,\n  theft_detection_enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,\n  \n  status TEXT DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive', 'maintenance', 'decommissioned')),\n  \n  latitude DECIMAL(10,8),\n  longitude DECIMAL(11,8),\n  physical_location TEXT,\n  \n  installation_date DATE,\n  notes TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 5: SENSOR READINGS (Time-series data)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensor_readings (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  tank_id UUID REFERENCES tanks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  \n  raw_distance DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, -- mm\n  temperature DECIMAL(5,2), -- ┬░C\n  signal_strength INTEGER, -- RSSI\n  \n  corrected_distance DECIMAL(10,2), -- After Newton-Laplace correction\n  ambient_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  standard_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  fill_percentage DECIMAL(5,2),\n  \n  reading_quality TEXT CHECK (reading_quality IN ('excellent', 'good', 'fair', 'poor', 'error')),\n  error_code TEXT,\n  \n  timestamp TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 6: ALERTS \u0026 NOTIFICATIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS alerts (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  tank_id UUID REFERENCES tanks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  alert_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (alert_type IN (\n    'theft_detected', 'leak_detected', 'low_fuel', 'high_temperature', 'sensor_offline', 'calibration_due', 'payment_overdue', 'delivery_variance', 'system_error'\n  )),\n  \n  severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('critical', 'warning', 'info')),\n  \n  title TEXT NOT NULL,\n  message TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  alert_data JSONB,\n  \n  is_read BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  is_acknowledged BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMP,\n  acknowledged_by TEXT,\n  \n  sms_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  sms_sent_at TIMESTAMP,\n  email_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  email_sent_at TIMESTAMP,\n  push_sent BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  push_sent_at TIMESTAMP,\n  \n  is_resolved BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,\n  resolved_at TIMESTAMP,\n  resolution_notes TEXT,\n  \n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  expires_at TIMESTAMP\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:15 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE 7: DELIVERY VERIFICATION (BOL Tracking)\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n  tank_id UUID REFERENCES tanks(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  delivery_date TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,\n  supplier_name TEXT,\n  driver_name TEXT,\n  truck_number TEXT,\n  \n  bol_number TEXT,\n  bol_claimed_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  bol_temperature DECIMAL(5,2),\n  bol_photo_url TEXT,\n  \n  tank_before_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  tank_after_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  actual_received_volume DECIMAL(10,2),\n  actual_temperature DECIMAL(5,2),\n  \n  variance_volume DECIMAL(10,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (bol_claimed_volume - actual_received_volume) STORED,\n  variance_percentage DECIMAL(5,2),\n  \n  verification_status TEXT CHECK (verification_status IN (\n    'pending', 'verified_ok', 'disputed_shortage', 'disputed_overage', 'under_investigation', 'resolved'\n  )),\n  \n  is_accepted BOOLEAN,\n  dispute_notes TEXT,\n  resolution_notes TEXT,\n  \n  unit_price DECIMAL(10,2),\n  total_cost DECIMAL(12,2),\n  \n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:17 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260317000004_fuel_transactions.sql\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fuel_transactions (\n    id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n    client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    tank_id UUID REFERENCES tanks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (transaction_type IN ('delivery', 'reconciliation', 'adjustment', 'loss', 'sale', 'purchase')),\n    amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, -- Volume in liters\n    timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),\n    performed_by_uid TEXT, -- Firebase UID\n    metadata JSONB DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,\n    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:19 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260317000006_update_firebase_uid.sql\n\n-- Helper function to get current user's firebase_uid from metadata\n-- Update: Support custom header 'x-firebase-uid' to bypass 401 signature validation \n-- when using Firebase Authentication alongside Supabase without Third-Party JWTs.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.firebase_uid() \nRETURNS TEXT AS $$\n  SELECT COALESCE(\n    nullif(current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'sub', ''),\n    current_setting('request.headers', true)::json-\u003e\u003e'x-firebase-uid'\n  );\n$$ LANGUAGE SQL STABLE","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- DATABASE HELPER FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_standard_volume(\n  ambient_volume DECIMAL,\n  current_temp DECIMAL,\n  fuel_type TEXT\n) RETURNS DECIMAL AS $$\nDECLARE\n  thermal_expansion_coef DECIMAL;\n  standard_temp DECIMAL := 15.5;\n  standard_volume DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  thermal_expansion_coef := CASE fuel_type\n    WHEN 'diesel' THEN 0.00085\n    WHEN 'petrol' THEN 0.00120\n    WHEN 'kerosene' THEN 0.00095\n    ELSE 0.00100\n  END;\n  standard_volume := ambient_volume / (1 + thermal_expansion_coef * (current_temp - standard_temp));\n  RETURN ROUND(standard_volume, 2);\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_debt_to_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_description TEXT,\n  p_transaction_type TEXT DEFAULT 'charge'\n) RETURNS UUID\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT firebase_uid INTO v_firebase_uid\n  FROM client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  UPDATE client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt + p_amount, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  INSERT INTO transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_status\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, p_transaction_type, p_amount, p_description, 'completed'\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION process_payment(\n  p_client_id UUID, p_amount DECIMAL, p_payment_method TEXT, p_payment_reference TEXT, p_description TEXT DEFAULT 'Payment received'\n) RETURNS UUID\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\n  v_current_debt DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT current_debt, firebase_uid INTO v_current_debt, v_firebase_uid\n  FROM client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  IF p_amount \u003e v_current_debt THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment amount exceeds current debt';\n  END IF;\n  \n  UPDATE client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt - p_amount, total_paid = total_paid + p_amount,\n      last_payment_date = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(),\n      account_status = CASE WHEN (current_debt - p_amount) \u003c= 0 THEN 'active' ELSE account_status END\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  INSERT INTO transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_method, payment_reference, payment_status, completed_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, 'payment', p_amount, p_description, p_payment_method, p_payment_reference, 'completed', NOW()\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_dashboard_summary(p_firebase_uid TEXT)\nRETURNS JSON\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_summary JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'billing', (\n      SELECT json_build_object(\n        'current_debt', current_debt, 'total_paid', total_paid, 'subscription_tier', subscription_tier,\n        'account_status', account_status, 'next_billing_date', next_billing_date\n      ) FROM client_billing WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid\n    ),\n    'tanks', (\n      SELECT json_agg(\n        json_build_object(\n          'id', id, 'name', tank_name, 'fuel_type', fuel_type, 'current_volume', current_volume,\n          'capacity', tank_capacity, 'fill_percentage', ROUND((current_volume / tank_capacity * 100)::NUMERIC, 2),\n          'temperature', current_temperature, 'status', status\n        )\n      ) FROM tanks WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND status = 'active'\n    ),\n    'unread_alerts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND is_read = FALSE),\n    'critical_alerts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alerts WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND is_read = FALSE AND severity = 'critical')\n  ) INTO v_summary;\n  RETURN v_summary;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_monthly_usage_bill(\n  p_client_id UUID, p_billing_period_start DATE, p_billing_period_end DATE\n) RETURNS DECIMAL\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE v_total_cost DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) INTO v_total_cost\n  FROM usage_logs\n  WHERE client_id = p_client_id AND timestamp \u003e= p_billing_period_start AND timestamp \u003c= p_billing_period_end AND is_billed = FALSE;\n  RETURN v_total_cost;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION detect_theft_anomaly(\n  p_tank_id UUID, p_current_volume DECIMAL, p_time_window_minutes INTEGER DEFAULT 60\n) RETURNS JSON\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_baseline_mean DECIMAL;\n  v_baseline_stddev DECIMAL;\n  v_z_score DECIMAL;\n  v_is_anomaly BOOLEAN;\n  v_confidence DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT AVG(ambient_volume), STDDEV(ambient_volume) INTO v_baseline_mean, v_baseline_stddev\n  FROM sensor_readings\n  WHERE tank_id = p_tank_id AND timestamp \u003e= NOW() - (p_time_window_minutes || ' minutes')::INTERVAL\n    AND timestamp \u003c NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';\n  \n  IF v_baseline_stddev \u003e 0 THEN\n    v_z_score := (p_current_volume - v_baseline_mean) / v_baseline_stddev;\n  ELSE\n    v_z_score := 0;\n  END IF;\n  \n  v_is_anomaly := v_z_score \u003c -3.0;\n  v_confidence := LEAST(100, ABS(v_z_score) * 25);\n  \n  RETURN json_build_object(\n    'is_theft_detected', v_is_anomaly, 'confidence_score', ROUND(v_confidence, 2),\n    'z_score', ROUND(v_z_score, 2), 'baseline_mean', ROUND(v_baseline_mean, 2),\n    'current_volume', p_current_volume, 'volume_drop', ROUND(v_baseline_mean - p_current_volume, 2)\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_supplier_reliability_score(p_supplier_name TEXT) \nRETURNS JSON \nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE v_score JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'supplier_name', p_supplier_name, 'total_deliveries', COUNT(*),\n    'verified_ok', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'verified_ok'),\n    'disputed_shortages', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'disputed_shortage'),\n    'avg_variance_percentage', ROUND(AVG(variance_percentage)::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'reliability_score', ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'verified_ok')::DECIMAL / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2)\n  ) INTO v_score\n  FROM deliveries WHERE supplier_name = p_supplier_name AND created_at \u003e= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months';\n  RETURN v_score;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- DATABASE TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_delivery_variance() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  NEW.actual_received_volume := NEW.tank_after_volume - NEW.tank_before_volume;\n  IF NEW.bol_claimed_volume \u003e 0 THEN\n    NEW.variance_percentage := ROUND(((NEW.bol_claimed_volume - NEW.actual_received_volume) / NEW.bol_claimed_volume * 100)::NUMERIC, 2);\n  END IF;\n  \n  IF ABS(NEW.variance_percentage) \u003c= 1.67 THEN\n    NEW.verification_status := 'verified_ok'; NEW.is_accepted := TRUE;\n  ELSIF NEW.variance_percentage \u003e 1.67 THEN\n    NEW.verification_status := 'disputed_shortage'; NEW.is_accepted := FALSE;\n  ELSE\n    NEW.verification_status := 'disputed_overage'; NEW.is_accepted := FALSE;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:20 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_tank_thresholds() RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_client_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT client_id, firebase_uid INTO v_client_id, v_firebase_uid FROM tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id;\n  IF NEW.ambient_volume \u003c= (SELECT low_level_threshold FROM tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id) THEN\n    INSERT INTO alerts (client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data)\n    VALUES (v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'low_fuel', 'warning', 'Low Fuel Level Alert', 'Tank has reached low fuel threshold. Consider reordering.', json_build_object('current_volume', NEW.ambient_volume, 'threshold', (SELECT low_level_threshold FROM tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id)));\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.temperature \u003e= (SELECT high_temperature_threshold FROM tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id) THEN\n    INSERT INTO alerts (client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data)\n    VALUES (v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'high_temperature', 'critical', 'High Temperature Alert', 'Tank temperature has exceeded safety threshold!', json_build_object('current_temp', NEW.temperature, 'threshold', (SELECT high_temperature_threshold FROM tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id)));\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260318000000_superadmin_setup.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- SYSTEM LAYER: SUPER ADMIN \u0026 HELPER ROLES\n-- ============================================================================\n-- Adds the necessary system-level tables for platform owners and administrators.\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE: SYSTEM USERS (Replaces admin_users)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS system_users (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  firebase_uid TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,\n  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  -- Role definitions\n  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN (\n    'super_admin',    -- Level 1: Platform Owner (Joseph)\n    'admin_helper',   -- Level 2: Team Leads (Ann)\n    'support_staff',  -- Level 3: CS Team\n    'analyst'         -- Level 4: Read-Only\n  )),\n  \n  is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,\n  \n  -- Record who created this admin account\n  created_by UUID REFERENCES system_users(id),\n  \n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLE: ADMIN LOGS (Audit Trail)\n-- ============================================================================\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_logs (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n  system_user_id UUID REFERENCES system_users(id), -- Who performed the action\n  firebase_uid TEXT NOT NULL, -- Keep record even if system_user is dropped\n  \n  action_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action_type IN (\n    'debt_adjusted',\n    'client_suspended',\n    'client_reactivated',\n    'system_settings_changed',\n    'admin_unlocked',\n    'payment_manually_recorded',\n    'user_role_changed',\n    'emergency_shutdown'\n  )),\n  \n  affected_client_id UUID REFERENCES client_billing(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n  \n  description TEXT NOT NULL,\n  \n  -- Snapshot of what changed JSON format: {\"before\": {...}, \"after\": {...}}\n  changes_made JSONB,\n  \n  ip_address INET,\n  user_agent TEXT,\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_system_admin(minimum_role TEXT DEFAULT NULL)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  user_role TEXT;\n  user_active BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  -- Fetch caching status\n  SELECT role, is_active INTO user_role, user_active\n  FROM system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = public.firebase_uid();\n  \n  -- Must exist and be active\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT user_active THEN\n    RETURN FALSE;\n  END IF;\n\n  -- If a required role is specified, evaluate permission hierarchy\n  IF minimum_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF minimum_role = 'super_admin' AND user_role != 'super_admin' THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n    \n    IF minimum_role = 'admin_helper' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper') THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n    \n    IF minimum_role = 'support_staff' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper', 'support_staff') THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN TRUE;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:26 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- 4. `pending_registrations` access\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM information_schema.tables\n    WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      AND table_name = 'pending_registrations'\n  ) THEN\n    ALTER TABLE public.pending_registrations ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n    -- Allow anyone (including unauthenticated clients) to submit a registration request\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Anyone can submit a registration request\" ON public.pending_registrations;\n    CREATE POLICY \"Anyone can submit a registration request\"\n    ON public.pending_registrations FOR INSERT\n    TO anon, authenticated\n    WITH CHECK (email IS NOT NULL AND full_name IS NOT NULL);\n\n    -- Allow super admins and admin helpers to view and manage all registrations\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Admins can manage all registrations\" ON public.pending_registrations;\n    CREATE POLICY \"Admins can manage all registrations\"\n    ON public.pending_registrations FOR ALL\n    TO authenticated, anon\n    USING (is_system_admin('support_staff'))\n    WITH CHECK (is_system_admin('support_staff'));\n  ELSE\n    RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping policies: public.pending_registrations table does not exist yet';\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:27 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- supabase/migrations/20260318000001_superadmin_functions.sql\n-- ============================================================================\n-- SUPER ADMIN FUNCTIONS - SECURE ACTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Function 1: Securely adjust a client's debt\n-- This guarantees the transaction logs, the debt change, and the admin log happen atomically.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_adjust_client_debt(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_adjustment_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_new_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Identify and verify the admin\n  v_admin_uid := auth.uid()::text;\n  \n  SELECT id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND is_active = TRUE\n    AND role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only active Super Admins and Admin Helpers can adjust debt.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Fetch current client data\n  SELECT current_debt INTO v_old_debt\n  FROM client_billing\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  IF v_old_debt IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client not found.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 3. Calculate new debt\n  v_new_debt := v_old_debt + p_adjustment_amount;\n  IF v_new_debt \u003c 0 THEN\n    v_new_debt := 0; -- Floor at exactly 0\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 4. Update the client_billing table\n  UPDATE client_billing\n  SET current_debt = v_new_debt,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  -- 5. Record the financial transaction\n  INSERT INTO transactions (\n    client_id, \n    firebase_uid, \n    transaction_type, \n    amount, \n    description, \n    payment_status,\n    created_by\n  )\n  SELECT \n    p_client_id, \n    firebase_uid, \n    'adjustment', \n    ABS(p_adjustment_amount), \n    p_reason, \n    'completed',\n    v_admin_uid\n  FROM client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id\n  RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n\n  -- 6. Record in system admin_logs for audit\n  INSERT INTO admin_logs (\n    system_user_id,\n    firebase_uid,\n    action_type,\n    affected_client_id,\n    description,\n    changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id,\n    v_admin_uid,\n    'debt_adjusted',\n    p_client_id,\n    'Manually adjusted debt: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'before', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_old_debt),\n      'after', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_new_debt),\n      'transaction_id', v_transaction_id\n    )\n  );\n\n  -- 7. Return success standard\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object(\n    'success', true,\n    'old_debt', v_old_debt,\n    'new_debt', v_new_debt\n  );\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:27 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Function 2: Suspend a client account\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_suspend_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  -- 1. Identify and verify the admin\n  v_admin_uid := auth.uid()::text;\n  \n  SELECT id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND is_active = TRUE\n    AND role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admins and Admin Helpers can suspend accounts.';\n  END IF;\n\n  -- 2. Update client_billing account tracking\n  SELECT account_status INTO v_old_status FROM client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  UPDATE client_billing\n  SET account_status = 'suspended',\n      suspension_reason = p_reason,\n      updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  -- 3. Audit trail\n  INSERT INTO admin_logs (\n    system_user_id,\n    firebase_uid,\n    action_type,\n    affected_client_id,\n    description,\n    changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id,\n    v_admin_uid,\n    'client_suspended',\n    p_client_id,\n    'Suspended account. Reason: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before_status', v_old_status, 'after_status', 'suspended')\n  );\n\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Ensure tenant resolver exists before any RLS policies reference it.\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_client_id()\nRETURNS UUID\nSECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public, auth\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_client_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT client_id INTO v_client_id\n  FROM public.profiles\n  WHERE supabase_uid = auth.uid()\n  LIMIT 1;\n  RETURN COALESCE(v_client_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid);\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql STABLE","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_system_admin(required_role TEXT DEFAULT NULL)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$\nDECLARE\n  user_role TEXT;\n  user_active BOOLEAN;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT role, is_active INTO user_role, user_active\n  FROM public.system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = auth.uid()::text;\n  \n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT user_active THEN\n    RETURN FALSE;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF required_role IS NOT NULL THEN\n    IF required_role = 'super_admin' AND user_role != 'super_admin' THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n    IF required_role = 'admin_helper' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper') THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n    IF required_role = 'support_staff' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper', 'support_staff') THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n    IF required_role = 'analyst' AND user_role NOT IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper', 'support_staff', 'analyst') THEN\n      RETURN FALSE;\n    END IF;\n  END IF;\n\n  RETURN TRUE;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================\n-- FINANCIAL FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_debt_to_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_description TEXT,\n  p_transaction_type TEXT DEFAULT 'charge'\n) RETURNS UUID AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT firebase_uid INTO v_firebase_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt + p_amount, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_status\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, p_transaction_type, p_amount, p_description, 'completed'\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION process_payment(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_payment_method TEXT,\n  p_payment_reference TEXT,\n  p_description TEXT DEFAULT 'Payment received'\n) RETURNS UUID AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\n  v_current_debt DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT current_debt, firebase_uid INTO v_current_debt, v_firebase_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  IF p_amount \u003e v_current_debt THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment amount exceeds current debt';\n  END IF;\n  \n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt - p_amount,\n      total_paid = total_paid + p_amount,\n      last_payment_date = NOW(), updated_at = NOW(),\n      account_status = CASE WHEN (current_debt - p_amount) \u003c= 0 THEN 'active' ELSE account_status END\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  \n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description,\n    payment_method, payment_reference, payment_status, completed_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, 'payment', p_amount, p_description,\n    p_payment_method, p_payment_reference, 'completed', NOW()\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_dashboard_summary(p_firebase_uid TEXT)\nRETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_summary JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'billing', (\n      SELECT json_build_object(\n        'current_debt', current_debt, 'total_paid', total_paid,\n        'subscription_tier', subscription_tier, 'account_status', account_status,\n        'next_billing_date', next_billing_date\n      ) FROM public.client_billing WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid\n    ),\n    'tanks', (\n      SELECT json_agg(\n        json_build_object(\n          'id', id, 'name', tank_name, 'fuel_type', fuel_type,\n          'current_volume', current_volume, 'capacity', tank_capacity,\n          'fill_percentage', ROUND((current_volume / tank_capacity * 100)::NUMERIC, 2),\n          'temperature', current_temperature, 'status', status\n        )\n      ) FROM public.tanks WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND status = 'active'\n    ),\n    'unread_alerts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND is_read = FALSE),\n    'critical_alerts', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts WHERE firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND is_read = FALSE AND severity = 'critical')\n  ) INTO v_summary;\n  RETURN v_summary;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_monthly_usage_bill(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_billing_period_start DATE,\n  p_billing_period_end DATE\n) RETURNS DECIMAL AS $$\nDECLARE v_total_cost DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) INTO v_total_cost\n  FROM public.usage_logs\n  WHERE client_id = p_client_id\n    AND timestamp \u003e= p_billing_period_start\n    AND timestamp \u003c= p_billing_period_end\n    AND is_billed = FALSE;\n  RETURN v_total_cost;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Admin debt adjustment (Phase 2 super admin function)\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_adjust_client_debt(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_adjustment_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_new_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := auth.uid()::text;\n  SELECT id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = v_admin_uid AND is_active = TRUE\n    AND role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only active Super Admins and Admin Helpers can adjust debt.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT current_debt INTO v_old_debt FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  IF v_old_debt IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client not found.'; END IF;\n  v_new_debt := GREATEST(0, v_old_debt + p_adjustment_amount);\n  UPDATE public.client_billing SET current_debt = v_new_debt, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_status, created_by\n  )\n  SELECT p_client_id, firebase_uid, 'adjustment', ABS(p_adjustment_amount), p_reason, 'completed', v_admin_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id\n  RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id, firebase_uid, action_type, affected_client_id, description, changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id, v_admin_uid, 'debt_adjusted', p_client_id,\n    'Manually adjusted debt: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_old_debt), 'after', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_new_debt), 'transaction_id', v_transaction_id)\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'old_debt', v_old_debt, 'new_debt', v_new_debt);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_suspend_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := auth.uid()::text;\n  SELECT id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users\n  WHERE firebase_uid = v_admin_uid AND is_active = TRUE\n    AND role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admins and Admin Helpers can suspend accounts.';\n  END IF;\n  SELECT account_status INTO v_old_status FROM public.client_billing WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET account_status = 'suspended', suspension_reason = p_reason, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id, firebase_uid, action_type, affected_client_id, description, changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id, v_admin_uid, 'client_suspended', p_client_id,\n    'Suspended account. Reason: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before_status', v_old_status, 'after_status', 'suspended')\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================\n-- TANK \u0026 SENSOR FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_standard_volume(\n  ambient_volume DECIMAL,\n  current_temp DECIMAL,\n  fuel_type TEXT\n) RETURNS DECIMAL AS $$\nDECLARE\n  thermal_expansion_coef DECIMAL;\n  standard_temp DECIMAL := 15.5;\n  standard_volume DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  thermal_expansion_coef := CASE fuel_type\n    WHEN 'diesel' THEN 0.00085\n    WHEN 'petrol' THEN 0.00120\n    WHEN 'kerosene' THEN 0.00095\n    ELSE 0.00100\n  END;\n  standard_volume := ambient_volume / (1 + thermal_expansion_coef * (current_temp - standard_temp));\n  RETURN ROUND(standard_volume, 2);\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION detect_theft_anomaly(\n  p_tank_id UUID,\n  p_current_volume DECIMAL,\n  p_time_window_minutes INTEGER DEFAULT 60\n) RETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_baseline_mean DECIMAL;\n  v_baseline_stddev DECIMAL;\n  v_z_score DECIMAL;\n  v_is_anomaly BOOLEAN;\n  v_confidence DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT AVG(ambient_volume), STDDEV(ambient_volume)\n  INTO v_baseline_mean, v_baseline_stddev\n  FROM public.sensor_readings\n  WHERE tank_id = p_tank_id\n    AND timestamp \u003e= NOW() - (p_time_window_minutes || ' minutes')::INTERVAL\n    AND timestamp \u003c NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';\n  IF v_baseline_stddev \u003e 0 THEN\n    v_z_score := (p_current_volume - v_baseline_mean) / v_baseline_stddev;\n  ELSE v_z_score := 0; END IF;\n  v_is_anomaly := v_z_score \u003c -3.0;\n  v_confidence := LEAST(100, ABS(v_z_score) * 25);\n  RETURN json_build_object(\n    'is_theft_detected', v_is_anomaly, 'confidence_score', ROUND(v_confidence, 2),\n    'z_score', ROUND(v_z_score, 2), 'baseline_mean', ROUND(v_baseline_mean, 2),\n    'current_volume', p_current_volume, 'volume_drop', ROUND(v_baseline_mean - p_current_volume, 2)\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_supplier_reliability_score(p_supplier_name TEXT)\nRETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE v_score JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'supplier_name', p_supplier_name, 'total_deliveries', COUNT(*),\n    'verified_ok', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'verified_ok'),\n    'disputed_shortages', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'disputed_shortage'),\n    'avg_variance_percentage', ROUND(AVG(variance_percentage)::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'reliability_score', ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE verification_status = 'verified_ok')::DECIMAL / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2)\n  ) INTO v_score\n  FROM public.deliveries WHERE supplier_name = p_supplier_name\n    AND created_at \u003e= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months';\n  RETURN v_score;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_delivery_variance()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  NEW.actual_received_volume := NEW.tank_after_volume - NEW.tank_before_volume;\n  IF NEW.bol_claimed_volume \u003e 0 THEN\n    NEW.variance_percentage := ROUND(((NEW.bol_claimed_volume - NEW.actual_received_volume) / NEW.bol_claimed_volume * 100)::NUMERIC, 2);\n  END IF;\n  IF ABS(NEW.variance_percentage) \u003c= 1.67 THEN\n    NEW.verification_status := 'verified_ok'; NEW.is_accepted := TRUE;\n  ELSIF NEW.variance_percentage \u003e 1.67 THEN\n    NEW.verification_status := 'disputed_shortage'; NEW.is_accepted := FALSE;\n  ELSE\n    NEW.verification_status := 'disputed_overage'; NEW.is_accepted := FALSE;\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_tank_thresholds()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_client_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT client_id, firebase_uid INTO v_client_id, v_firebase_uid\n  FROM public.tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id;\n  IF NEW.ambient_volume \u003c= (SELECT low_level_threshold FROM public.tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id) THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.alerts (client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data)\n    VALUES (v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'low_fuel', 'warning', 'Low Fuel Level Alert',\n      'Tank has reached low fuel threshold. Consider reordering.',\n      json_build_object('current_volume', NEW.ambient_volume, 'threshold', (SELECT low_level_threshold FROM public.tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id)));\n  END IF;\n  IF NEW.temperature \u003e= (SELECT high_temperature_threshold FROM public.tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id) THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.alerts (client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data)\n    VALUES (v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'high_temperature', 'critical', 'High Temperature Alert',\n      'Tank temperature has exceeded safety threshold!',\n      json_build_object('current_temp', NEW.temperature, 'threshold', (SELECT high_temperature_threshold FROM public.tanks WHERE id = NEW.tank_id)));\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION log_admin_action()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  IF public.is_admin() THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n      admin_firebase_uid, action_type, affected_client_id,\n      affected_resource_type, affected_resource_id, description, changes_made\n    )\n    VALUES (\n      public.firebase_uid(), TG_ARGV[0],\n      CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME = 'client_billing' THEN NEW.id\n           WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME = 'transactions' THEN NEW.client_id\n           ELSE NULL END,\n      TG_TABLE_NAME, NEW.id, TG_ARGV[1],\n      json_build_object('old', row_to_json(OLD), 'new', row_to_json(NEW))\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================\n-- FIX: Overly Permissive RLS Policies\n-- ============================\n\n-- Fix fuel_transactions (drop the always-true policy)\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM information_schema.tables\n    WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      AND table_name = 'fuel_transactions'\n  ) THEN\n    ALTER TABLE public.fuel_transactions ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n\n    -- Remove the overly-permissive fallback policy if present.\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Public fuel_transactions access\" ON public.fuel_transactions;\n\n    -- Align policy to actual schema: this table does not have a firebase_uid column.\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Clients can view own fuel transactions\" ON public.fuel_transactions;\n    CREATE POLICY \"Clients can view own fuel transactions\" ON public.fuel_transactions\n      FOR SELECT TO authenticated\n      USING (client_id = public.get_user_client_id());\n\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Clients can insert own fuel transactions\" ON public.fuel_transactions;\n    CREATE POLICY \"Clients can insert own fuel transactions\" ON public.fuel_transactions\n      FOR INSERT TO authenticated\n      WITH CHECK (client_id = public.get_user_client_id());\n  ELSE\n    RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping policies: public.fuel_transactions table does not exist yet';\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:28 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Fix market_bookmarks (drop the always-true policy)\nDO $$\nBEGIN\n  IF EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM information_schema.tables\n    WHERE table_schema = 'public'\n      AND table_name = 'market_bookmarks'\n  ) THEN\n    ALTER TABLE public.market_bookmarks ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Public market_bookmarks access\" ON public.market_bookmarks;\n\n    -- Align policy to actual schema: this table is scoped by client_id.\n    DROP POLICY IF EXISTS \"Clients can manage own market bookmarks\" ON public.market_bookmarks;\n    CREATE POLICY \"Clients can manage own market bookmarks\" ON public.market_bookmarks\n      FOR ALL TO authenticated\n      USING (client_id = public.get_user_client_id())\n      WITH CHECK (client_id = public.get_user_client_id());\n  ELSE\n    RAISE NOTICE 'Skipping policies: public.market_bookmarks table does not exist yet';\n  END IF;\nEND\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:29 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================================================================\n-- PART 2: pending_registrations table\n-- ============================================================================\n-- When a prospective client fills in the sign-up form on the client web,\n-- their details are stored here as a pending request.\n-- The Super Admin reviews these and can approve them to create the full account.\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.pending_registrations (\n  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),\n\n  -- Details submitted by the prospective client\n  full_name TEXT NOT NULL,\n  email TEXT NOT NULL,\n  phone TEXT,\n  station_name TEXT NOT NULL,   -- Name of their fuel station / company\n  county TEXT,\n  notes TEXT,                   -- Any extra notes they add\n\n  -- Status tracking\n  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'\n    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'contacted')),\n\n  -- Who processed the request (admin side)\n  reviewed_by TEXT,             -- firebase_uid of the system_user who reviewed\n  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP,\n  review_notes TEXT,\n\n  -- After approval, the firebase_uid created for this user\n  approved_firebase_uid TEXT,\n  approved_client_id UUID REFERENCES public.client_billing(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,\n\n  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW(),\n  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NOW()\n)","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- Returns TRUE if the caller is an active super_admin\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_admin()\nRETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$\nBEGIN\n  RETURN public.firebase_uid() IN (\n    SELECT su.firebase_uid\n    FROM public.system_users su\n    WHERE su.role = 'super_admin'\n      AND su.is_active = TRUE\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION is_system_admin(minimum_role TEXT DEFAULT NULL)\nRETURNS BOOLEAN AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_uid TEXT;\n  v_role TEXT;\n  v_active BOOLEAN;\n  role_order INT;\n  required_order INT;\nBEGIN\n  v_uid := public.firebase_uid();\n  IF v_uid IS NULL THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;\n\n  SELECT su.role, su.is_active INTO v_role, v_active\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE su.firebase_uid = v_uid;\n\n  IF NOT FOUND OR NOT v_active THEN RETURN FALSE; END IF;\n  IF minimum_role IS NULL THEN RETURN TRUE; END IF;\n\n  -- Map roles to numeric order (higher = more privileged)\n  role_order := CASE v_role\n    WHEN 'super_admin'   THEN 4\n    WHEN 'admin_helper'  THEN 3\n    WHEN 'support_staff' THEN 2\n    WHEN 'analyst'       THEN 1\n    ELSE 0\n  END;\n\n  required_order := CASE minimum_role\n    WHEN 'super_admin'   THEN 4\n    WHEN 'admin_helper'  THEN 3\n    WHEN 'support_staff' THEN 2\n    WHEN 'analyst'       THEN 1\n    ELSE 0\n  END;\n\n  RETURN role_order \u003e= required_order;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================\n-- FINANCIAL FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION add_debt_to_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_description TEXT,\n  p_transaction_type TEXT DEFAULT 'charge'\n) RETURNS UUID AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT cb.firebase_uid INTO v_firebase_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.id = p_client_id;\n\n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt + p_amount, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_status\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, p_transaction_type, p_amount, p_description, 'completed'\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION process_payment(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_payment_method TEXT,\n  p_payment_reference TEXT,\n  p_description TEXT DEFAULT 'Payment received'\n) RETURNS UUID AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\n  v_current_debt DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT cb.current_debt, cb.firebase_uid\n  INTO v_current_debt, v_firebase_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.id = p_client_id;\n\n  IF p_amount \u003e v_current_debt THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Payment amount exceeds current debt';\n  END IF;\n\n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET current_debt = current_debt - p_amount,\n      total_paid = total_paid + p_amount,\n      last_payment_date = NOW(),\n      updated_at = NOW(),\n      account_status = CASE WHEN (current_debt - p_amount) \u003c= 0 THEN 'active' ELSE account_status END\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description,\n    payment_method, payment_reference, payment_status, completed_at\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_firebase_uid, 'payment', p_amount, p_description,\n    p_payment_method, p_payment_reference, 'completed', NOW()\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n  RETURN v_transaction_id;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_client_dashboard_summary(p_firebase_uid TEXT)\nRETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE v_summary JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'billing', (\n      SELECT json_build_object(\n        'current_debt', cb.current_debt,\n        'total_paid', cb.total_paid,\n        'subscription_tier', cb.subscription_tier,\n        'account_status', cb.account_status,\n        'next_billing_date', cb.next_billing_date\n      ) FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid\n    ),\n    'tanks', (\n      SELECT json_agg(\n        json_build_object(\n          'id', t.id, 'name', t.tank_name, 'fuel_type', t.fuel_type,\n          'current_volume', t.current_volume, 'capacity', t.tank_capacity,\n          'fill_percentage', ROUND((t.current_volume / NULLIF(t.tank_capacity, 0) * 100)::NUMERIC, 2),\n          'temperature', t.current_temperature, 'status', t.status\n        )\n      ) FROM public.tanks t WHERE t.firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND t.status = 'active'\n    ),\n    'unread_alerts', (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts a\n      WHERE a.firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND a.is_read = FALSE\n    ),\n    'critical_alerts', (\n      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.alerts a\n      WHERE a.firebase_uid = p_firebase_uid AND a.is_read = FALSE AND a.severity = 'critical'\n    )\n  ) INTO v_summary;\n  RETURN v_summary;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_adjust_client_debt(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_adjustment_amount DECIMAL,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_new_debt DECIMAL;\n  v_transaction_id UUID;\n  v_fb_uid TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := public.firebase_uid();\n  SELECT su.id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE su.firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND su.is_active = TRUE\n    AND su.role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only active Super Admins and Admin Helpers can adjust debt.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT cb.current_debt, cb.firebase_uid INTO v_old_debt, v_fb_uid\n  FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.id = p_client_id;\n  IF v_old_debt IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Client not found.'; END IF;\n\n  v_new_debt := GREATEST(0, v_old_debt + p_adjustment_amount);\n  UPDATE public.client_billing SET current_debt = v_new_debt, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.transactions (\n    client_id, firebase_uid, transaction_type, amount, description, payment_status, created_by\n  ) VALUES (\n    p_client_id, v_fb_uid, 'adjustment', ABS(p_adjustment_amount), p_reason, 'completed', v_admin_uid\n  ) RETURNING id INTO v_transaction_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id, firebase_uid, action_type, affected_client_id, description, changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id, v_admin_uid, 'debt_adjusted', p_client_id,\n    'Manually adjusted debt: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_old_debt),\n                       'after', jsonb_build_object('current_debt', v_new_debt),\n                       'transaction_id', v_transaction_id)\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'old_debt', v_old_debt, 'new_debt', v_new_debt);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION admin_suspend_client(\n  p_client_id UUID,\n  p_reason TEXT\n) RETURNS JSONB\nLANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER\nSET search_path = public\nAS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_admin_uid TEXT;\n  v_system_user_id UUID;\n  v_old_status TEXT;\nBEGIN\n  v_admin_uid := public.firebase_uid();\n  SELECT su.id INTO v_system_user_id\n  FROM public.system_users su\n  WHERE su.firebase_uid = v_admin_uid\n    AND su.is_active = TRUE\n    AND su.role IN ('super_admin', 'admin_helper');\n  IF v_system_user_id IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unauthorized: Only Super Admins and Admin Helpers can suspend accounts.';\n  END IF;\n\n  SELECT cb.account_status INTO v_old_status FROM public.client_billing cb WHERE cb.id = p_client_id;\n  UPDATE public.client_billing\n  SET account_status = 'suspended', suspension_reason = p_reason, updated_at = NOW()\n  WHERE id = p_client_id;\n\n  INSERT INTO public.admin_logs (\n    system_user_id, firebase_uid, action_type, affected_client_id, description, changes_made\n  ) VALUES (\n    v_system_user_id, v_admin_uid, 'client_suspended', p_client_id,\n    'Suspended account. Reason: ' || p_reason,\n    jsonb_build_object('before_status', v_old_status, 'after_status', 'suspended')\n  );\n  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true);\nEND;\n$$","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"-- ============================\n-- TANK \u0026 SENSOR FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================\n\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_standard_volume(\n  ambient_volume DECIMAL,\n  current_temp DECIMAL,\n  fuel_type TEXT\n) RETURNS DECIMAL AS $$\nDECLARE\n  thermal_coef DECIMAL;\n  std_temp DECIMAL := 15.5;\nBEGIN\n  thermal_coef := CASE fuel_type\n    WHEN 'diesel'   THEN 0.00085\n    WHEN 'petrol'   THEN 0.00120\n    WHEN 'kerosene' THEN 0.00095\n    ELSE 0.00100\n  END;\n  RETURN ROUND((ambient_volume / (1 + thermal_coef * (current_temp - std_temp)))::NUMERIC, 2);\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION detect_theft_anomaly(\n  p_tank_id UUID,\n  p_current_volume DECIMAL,\n  p_time_window_minutes INTEGER DEFAULT 60\n) RETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_mean DECIMAL;\n  v_stddev DECIMAL;\n  v_z DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT AVG(sr.ambient_volume), STDDEV(sr.ambient_volume)\n  INTO v_mean, v_stddev\n  FROM public.sensor_readings sr\n  WHERE sr.tank_id = p_tank_id\n    AND sr.timestamp \u003e= NOW() - (p_time_window_minutes || ' minutes')::INTERVAL\n    AND sr.timestamp \u003c NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes';\n\n  v_z := CASE WHEN v_stddev \u003e 0 THEN (p_current_volume - v_mean) / v_stddev ELSE 0 END;\n\n  RETURN json_build_object(\n    'is_theft_detected', v_z \u003c -3.0,\n    'confidence_score', ROUND(LEAST(100, ABS(v_z) * 25)::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'z_score', ROUND(v_z::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'baseline_mean', ROUND(v_mean::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'current_volume', p_current_volume,\n    'volume_drop', ROUND((v_mean - p_current_volume)::NUMERIC, 2)\n  );\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_supplier_reliability_score(p_supplier_name TEXT)\nRETURNS JSON AS $$\nDECLARE v_score JSON;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT json_build_object(\n    'supplier_name', p_supplier_name,\n    'total_deliveries', COUNT(*),\n    'verified_ok', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.verification_status = 'verified_ok'),\n    'disputed_shortages', COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.verification_status = 'disputed_shortage'),\n    'avg_variance_percentage', ROUND(AVG(d.variance_percentage)::NUMERIC, 2),\n    'reliability_score', ROUND((\n      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.verification_status = 'verified_ok')::DECIMAL\n      / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100\n    )::NUMERIC, 2)\n  ) INTO v_score\n  FROM public.deliveries d\n  WHERE d.supplier_name = p_supplier_name\n    AND d.created_at \u003e= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months';\n  RETURN v_score;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION calculate_delivery_variance()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nBEGIN\n  NEW.actual_received_volume := NEW.tank_after_volume - NEW.tank_before_volume;\n  IF NEW.bol_claimed_volume \u003e 0 THEN\n    NEW.variance_percentage := ROUND(\n      ((NEW.bol_claimed_volume - NEW.actual_received_volume) / NEW.bol_claimed_volume * 100)::NUMERIC, 2\n    );\n  END IF;\n  NEW.verification_status := CASE\n    WHEN ABS(NEW.variance_percentage) \u003c= 1.67 THEN 'verified_ok'\n    WHEN NEW.variance_percentage \u003e 1.67       THEN 'disputed_shortage'\n    ELSE 'disputed_overage'\n  END;\n  NEW.is_accepted := ABS(NEW.variance_percentage) \u003c= 1.67;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}

2026/04/08 22:24:30 PG Send: {"Type":"Parse","Name":"","Query":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION check_tank_thresholds()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nDECLARE\n  v_client_id UUID;\n  v_firebase_uid TEXT;\n  v_low_threshold DECIMAL;\n  v_high_temp DECIMAL;\nBEGIN\n  SELECT t.client_id, t.firebase_uid, t.low_level_threshold, t.high_temperature_threshold\n  INTO v_client_id, v_firebase_uid, v_low_threshold, v_high_temp\n  FROM public.tanks t WHERE t.id = NEW.tank_id;\n\n  IF NEW.ambient_volume \u003c= v_low_threshold THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.alerts (\n      client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'low_fuel', 'warning',\n      'Low Fuel Level Alert', 'Tank has reached low fuel threshold. Consider reordering.',\n      json_build_object('current_volume', NEW.ambient_volume, 'threshold', v_low_threshold)\n    );\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NEW.temperature \u003e= v_high_temp THEN\n    INSERT INTO public.alerts (\n      client_id, tank_id, firebase_uid, alert_type, severity, title, message, alert_data\n    ) VALUES (\n      v_client_id, NEW.tank_id, v_firebase_uid, 'high_temperature', 'critical',\n      'High Temperature Alert', 'Tank temperature has exceeded safety threshold!',\n      json_build_object('current_temp', NEW.temperature, 'threshold', v_high_temp)\n    );\n  END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\nEND;\n$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path = public","ParameterOIDs":null}
